This update gives the panel a more expressive radial-bands design and animated
sentiment effects whose intensity follows the displayed score.

## Highlights

- Replaces the thin gauge with labeled radial bands and a straight-edged arrow
  needle.
- Adds a glowing, continuously moving fire bed for Fear readings.
- Adds tumbling coins and fluttering banknotes for Greed readings.
- Makes both effects more prominent as the score approaches an extreme.
- Adds `Full`, `Subtle`, and `Off` animation settings.
- Stops and clears all animation when the panel closes.
- Adds focused animation tests and an isolated effects preview for contributors.

## Update

```bash
omarchy plugin update io.github.davidojedalopez.fear-greed
```
